name: wd_W2
_comment: JOB E phase 2 weight-decay pilot, written 2026-11-11 20:50 before any of these arms ran. Each arm repeats stage S2 of the phase-1 run exactly (it resumes a copy of _work/runs/main/stage_S1.pt: same model, Adam state, RNG and data position at 1.0B, then one cosine cycle 1.0B -> 2.0B with peak lr 5e-4, alpha 0.25), except for decoupled weight decay on the king-bucketed first-layer weights w1 (w1 *= 1 - lr * lambda after every step; the shared factoriser weights wf, the biases and the output layer are not decayed). W0 has no decay: it measures how far a repeat of S2 lands from S2 itself (run-to-run noise). A sample of 2,000,000 training rows is scored next to the selection set to show the fit gap.
